items.title: Chevron Aims to Double Venezuela Output
items.summary: Chevron has inked a deal to spend $7 billion in Venezuelan oil fields over the next five years. It adds two new undeveloped heavy oil fields to the company’s JV with state-run Petróleos de Venezuela. The expansion plan—a win for the Trump administration, which has prompted oil companies to invest there—will double Chevron’s output over five years to 600,000 barrels per day.
